claims.claim_ar: أداة الاستثناء «إِلَّا» هنا تفيد القصر والحصْر، فتستثني من العموم الذين ذكروا بعدها (تَابُوا، أَصْلَحُوا، ...).
claims.claim_en: The exception particle 'إِلَّا' (followed by 'الَّذِينَ') functions as restriction/exclusion, limiting the general statement to those specified afterwards (those who repented, reformed, held fast to God, etc.).

claims.claim_ar: تكرار لفظ «المؤمنين» (مَعَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ... الْمُؤْمِنِينَ) كوسيلة بلاغية للتأكيد والشدّة في الثواب والانتساب إلى الجماعة الإيمانية.
claims.claim_en: Repetition of the term 'mu'minīn' (the believers) functions as a rhetorical repetition to emphasize and intensify the promised reward and the believers' inclusion; the doubled mention reinforces communal belonging and divine recompense.
claims.needs_review_reason: The quoted form in the provided tafsir chunk is 'الْمُؤْمِنُونَ' (nominative spelling). Confirm match with the verse's vocalization and that the tafsir's discussion is intended as commentary on this repetition.

warnings: Only Zamakhshari (al-Kashshaf) chunks were provided. Requested authors (al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, al-Suyuti, tafsir-balagha sections) are not present; claims are therefore based solely on the supplied Zamakhshari excerpts.
